items.title: 1.5 Four Fourth Roots of Unity (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Is sabaq mein hum number 1 ke chaar fourth roots dhoondenge. Pichle sabaq mein aap ne \(x^{3} = 1\) se teen cube roots nikaale the. Aaj bilkul wahi tareeqa \(x^{4} = 1\) par lagayenge. Achhi khabar yeh hai ke yahan quadratic formula ki bhi zaroorat nahin parti; sirf ek factorization aur \(i\) ki pehchaan kaafi hai.
Fourth root of unity woh number hai jis ki chauthi power (fourth power) 1 ho. Maan lijiye \(x\) unity ka ek fourth root hai. To:

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Yahan kya hua? \(x^{4} - 1\) ko ghor se dekhiye: yeh \((x^{2})^{2} - 1^{2}\) hai, yani do squares ka farq (difference of two squares). Formula \(a^{2} - b^{2} = (a - b)(a + b)\) mein \(a = x^{2}\) aur \(b = 1\) rakhne se \((x^{2} - 1)(x^{2} + 1)\) mil jata hai.
Ab wahi purana usool: product zero hai, to koi ek factor zaroor zero hoga. Is liye do chhoti equations hal karni hain.
Dono factors ko alag alag zero rakhne se yeh milta hai:

Pehla factor humein do real roots deta hai, \(1\) aur \(-1\), jo aap pehle se jaante the. Doosra factor woh roots deta hai jo real numbers mein mumkin hi nahin the: kis number ka square \(-1\) hai? Bilkul, \(i\) ka, kyun ke definition hi \(i^{2} = -1\) hai; aur \(-i\) ka bhi, kyun ke \((-i)^{2} = i^{2} = -1\). Is tarah unity ke chaar fourth roots yeh hain: \(1, -1, i, -i\).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Har ek ko check kar ke dekhiye ke chauthi power waqai 1 hai: \(1^{4} = 1\), \((-1)^{4} = 1\), \(i^{4} = (i^{2})^{2} = (-1)^{2} = 1\), \((-i)^{4} = (i^{2})^{2} = 1\).
Do roots real hain (\(\pm1\)) aur do imaginary hain (\(\pm i\)). Yeh Fundamental theorem of algebra ke bilkul mutabiq hai: \(x^{4} = 1\) ki degree 4 hai, is liye bilkul chaar roots.
Argand diagram par socheiye: yeh chaar points \((1, 0)\), \((-1, 0)\), \((0, 1)\), \((0, -1)\) hain, yani origin se ek hi faasle par chaaron simton (mashriq, maghrib, shimaal, junoob) mein. Khud sochiye: in sab ka modulus kitna hai? (Jawab: 1.)

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Unity ke fourth roots woh numbers hain jo \(x^{4} = 1\) ko poora karte hain: \(1, -1, i, -i\).
2. Yeh \((x^{2} - 1)(x^{2} + 1) = 0\) se aate hain: pehla factor \(\pm1\), doosra \(\pm i\).
3. Degree 4, is liye roots bhi 4: do real aur do imaginary.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(x = \pm1\) par ruk jana: factor \(x^{2} + 1 = 0\) se do aur roots \(\pm i\) aate hain. Bachne ka tareeqa: degree dekh kar pehle se tay kar lein ke kitne roots chahiye.
2. \(\sqrt{-1} = -1\) likh dena: \(\sqrt{-1} = i\) hai.
3. Sirf \(i\) likhna aur \(-i\) bhool jana: \(x^{2} = -1\) ke bhi do roots hain, \(\pm i\).
